description: SPENDS MONEY. Launch an approved draft using its exact approvalToken from create/edit/get_chatgpt_ads, or resume a paused campaign within its existing lifetime budget. State budget, fee, duration and shared advertiser identity first; confirmed=true requires user approval. A pending_review result is awaiting review, not delivering. Repeat the same campaign ID to reconcile an uncertain launch; never create another draft as a retry.

approvalToken.description: Exact approvalToken from the draft’s latest quote; required to launch a draft, omitted to resume a paused ad.

campaignId.description: oriiion campaign ID returned by these tools, never an external account/ad ID.

confirmed.description: True only when the user has approved the stated money terms and shared advertiser identity.

name: start_chatgpt_ad
